display_long_description:
NEX is a beautifully designed VR video player that brings videos from your headset, computer, network, or USB together in one immersive experience.

# Watch in 3D your way

**Instant 3D**

Watch any video in NEX on Meta Quest 3 with Instant 3D. No computer or prior conversion needed.

**NEX Link 3D**

Convert 2D videos locally on your PC or Mac with an M series chip for richer detail and more consistent depth.

**Desktop 3D**

Stream your PC desktop to NEX and enjoy videos, games, and more with Desktop 3D.

[media]

# Built in web browser

Browse the web and open YouTube, Prime Video, Hulu, Disney+, and more directly in your private theater.

# MVC and Blu-ray ISO playback

Play MVC 3D videos from Blu-ray ISO files.

# Start watching instantly

Enter NEX and start watching.

Browse your library, switch videos, or continue playback without leaving the environment.

[media]

# Natural spatial controls

Spatial controls stay clear at any distance and can be customized with your favorite shortcuts.

[media]

# Immersive cinema spaces

Watch in photorealistic spaces, including a cinema hall, a quiet lakeside, and a warm modern cabin.

[media]

# Free to try, unlock once

Try NEX free for a limited time.

One purchase unlocks all features, environments, and unlimited 3D conversion.

NEX continues to evolve through updates and your feedback.


Website: https://nexplayer.net/

Join Discord: https://discord.gg/xdFpe3D3G6

Support: support@nexplayer.net
